headline: 带触觉的双臂操作数据集T-Rex，约50小时
title_en: T-Rex: A Bimanual Tactile Dataset in LeRobot Format
tagline_en: 50 hours of teleoperated bimanual manipulation with fingertip tactile and force data, in LeRobotDataset v3.0 format.
summary_md:
**What it is.** T-Rex is a large-scale teleoperation dataset from the T-Rex project (Zhuoyang Liu et al.; paper on arXiv). It was collected on a Dexmate Vega-1 dual-arm robot fitted with two Sharpa Wave dexterous hands. The data covers 5,464 episodes, about 50 hours at 30 fps, 22 motor primitives and 207 objects, with 5,370 language-annotated trajectories. Each frame has three RGB views (head plus two wrists), 10 raw tactile images and 10 deformation maps per hand, 6-axis fingertip wrenches, and 58-dim joint states and targets. It ships as a LeRobotDataset v3.0.

**Why it matters.** Most open manipulation datasets have parallel-jaw grippers and no touch. T-Rex pairs dexterous multi-finger hands with fingertip tactile and force readings, which is exactly the sensing that grasping and in-hand manipulation research needs. The hardware and teleoperation stack are also open-sourced, and there is a Colab notebook for loading the data.

**Can you try it without a robot?** Partly. You can load the dataset with LeRobot on any machine and replay videos and tactile signals in the notebook. Training a policy that transfers is not realistic here: the action space is 58-dimensional, the hands are special hardware, and the dataset is new, so community baselines are not yet established. Per the dataset card, watch first, train later.

pick.title: zekaiwang/trex_dataset
pick.one_liner: 一双灵巧手带触觉的双臂操作数据集，约50小时人类遥操作演示。
pick.one_liner_en: A 50-hour bimanual dexterous manipulation dataset with fingertip tactile sensing, collected by teleoperation.
pick.how_to_try: 用官方 Colab notebook 加载 LeRobot 数据集，浏览回放视频和触觉信号；别指望真机复现。
pick.how_to_try_en: Open the official Colab notebook to load the LeRobot dataset and explore videos plus tactile signals. No robot needed.
pick.reason: 规模大、模态全（含触觉与力）、开源彻底、有Colab，是本领域高质量数据；但硬件特殊，新人只能看数据不能复现训练。
red_flags: 触觉、灵巧手硬件极特殊，动作空间58维，模型基本无法在Mac上有意义地训练
论文与发布日期较新，社区复现与基准结果尚未验证

top.title: Embodied First Exam
top.one_liner: 给编程智能体出的机器人操作统一考试，最强智能体只考了 34 分
top.one_liner_en: A unified exam that tests coding agents on 1,156 robot tasks; the best agent scores only 34%.
top.how_to_try: 需按项目页搭建仿真环境并接入 GPT-6 等 API，无 GPU 的 Mac 只能先看失败分析。
top.how_to_try_en: You would set up the sim suite and call an LLM API; on a Mac with no GPU, just read the failure breakdown.
top.reason: 覆盖面广、评测视角新，是理解智能体控制机器人的好材料；但无代码、无 GPU 难以亲手尝试。
red_flags: 论文发表于 2026-11，目前只是一个预印本
还没有代码和许可证信息，热度极低
34% 成功率只是智能体的基线，尚不能说明方法的优劣

top.title: opentac/opentac
top.one_liner: 开源工具让你在电脑上设计、仿真和读取柔性触觉传感器皮肤
top.one_liner_en: Open toolkit to design, simulate and read flexible tactile sensor skins for any robot.
top.how_to_try: 运行 uv run opentac cad，在本地浏览器里画个形状，自动生成传感器板；再用 opentac.sim 做按压仿真，不需要机器人
top.how_to_try_en: Run 'uv run opentac cad' to design a sensor in your browser locally, then use opentac.sim to simulate presses—no robot needed.
top.reason: 开放度高、概念清晰，仿真和 CAD 部分 Mac 可玩，适合入门触觉感知；但需硬件才能真机验证，影响力中等
red_flags: 仓库信息很少、作者机构未知，热度低（97 星）
真正感知需要专用读出板硬件，纯软件只能仿真
发布与许可证信息需核实

top.title: InstantHMR : Real-Time Human Mesh Recovery on Your Phone
top.one_liner: 手机上一张照片毫秒级重建出3D人体网格
top.one_liner_en: Rebuilds a full 3D human mesh from one photo in milliseconds on a phone
top.how_to_try: Mac 上 clone 仓库跑单图推理；手机 NPU 加速需要安卓设备，没有就只看 demo
top.how_to_try_en: Clone the repo and run single-image inference on your Mac; phone NPU speed needs an Android device, otherwise just watch the demo.
top.reason: 工程扎实、速度快，但属感知侧小改进，与机器人本体和操作关系弱，适合当3D视觉入门。
red_flags: 偏移动端工程优化，对具身智能本身推动有限
与机器人控制/操作无直接关系

top.title: andrew-cartwheel/cartwheel-control
top.one_liner: 让人形机器人在仿真里跟着参考动作做全身运动跟踪
top.one_liner_en: Humanoid robots learn to mimic reference whole-body motions in simulation.
top.how_to_try: 用 Mac 装 uv，clone 仓库跑 cartwheel-play 看 MuJoCo 回放，改 motions 试新动作
top.how_to_try_en: Install uv on your Mac, clone the repo, run cartwheel-play to watch MuJoCo playback, then swap motions.
top.reason: 仿真版人形动作跟踪，仓库结构清晰、Mac 可跑，很适合入门学习；但未上真机、影响有限。
red_flags: 仅仿真，没上过真实机器人
许可证是自定义的 Cartwheel 协议，非标准开源
